propositions: Current clarity measure rewards volume and legacy shape rather than adherence to author-facing plan-writing contracts, allowing padded tickets to pass without required sections.
Clarity scoring logic is duplicated across _engine_support/gates.py and llm/plan_review/det_floor.py, creating maintenance drift and inviting future inconsistencies.

Seven recommended deterministic criteria (required-section shape, AC verification coverage, placeholder-free scope, grounded edit-set, AC hygiene, Testing shape, and structural signals) can be mechanically detected without semantic judgment.
Documentation conflict exists: author guides require rejected-alternative wording while authoritative criteria do not, creating ambiguity in clarity assessment.
Per-check evidence reporting and derived compatibility scoring should replace raw length/bullet counting to prevent filler compensation for missing required sections.
